MutatorStrings.HeadshotOnlyDescription: Bullets can only deal damage to the head.
MutatorStrings.VampirismDescription: Receive health when dealing damage to enemies equal to the amount of damage dealt.
MutatorStrings.LowGravityDescription: Float when jumping or falling, and shoot while midair.
MutatorStrings.HardcoreDescription: Mutator featuring slower movement speeds and longer capture times.
MutatorStrings.HotPotatoDescription: A live fragmentation grenade is dropped on death.
MutatorStrings.BoltActionsOnlyDescription: Only bolt-action rifles are available along with normal equipment and explosives.
MutatorStrings.PistolsOnlyDescription: Only pistols are available along with normal equipment and explosives.
MutatorStrings.AntiMaterielRiflesOnlyDescription: Only anti-materiel rifles are available along with normal equipment and explosives.
MutatorStrings.ShotgunsOnlyDescription: Only shotguns are available along with normal equipment and explosives.
MutatorStrings.OfficialRulesDescription: All gamemodes are forced to default rules.
MutatorStrings.CompetitiveDescription: Capturing objectives is faster and rounds are shorter.
MutatorStrings.SlowCaptureTimesDescription: Objectives will take longer to capture.
MutatorStrings.CompetitiveLoadoutsDescription: Player classes are replaced with those from Competitive.
MutatorStrings.FrenzyDescription: Enemy AI are faster and attack you with melee and Molotovs. Some have special abilities.
MutatorStrings.LockedAimDescription: Weapons always point to the center of the screen.
MutatorStrings.SoldierOfFortuneDescription: Gain 1 supply point every time you earn 50 score.
MutatorStrings.WelrodsDescription: Every player is forced to use the bolt-action Welrod pistol.
MutatorStrings.WelrodsOnlyDescription: Only bolt-action Welrod pistols are available along with normal equipment and explosives.
MutatorStrings.NoDropsDescription: No weapons or equipment are dropped when a person dies.
MutatorStrings.BudgetAntiquingDescription: Only cheap old weapons are available along with normal equipment and explosives.
MutatorStrings.MakarovsOnlyDescription: Only Makarov pistols are available along with normal equipment and explosives.
MutatorStrings.GunslingersDescription: Only revolvers are available along with normal equipment and explosives.
MutatorStrings.FullyLoadedDescription: Every weapon, upgrade, explosive, and piece of equipment is available in your Loadout.
MutatorStrings.TacticalVoiceChatDescription: Allows dead players to speak to the living, disables proximity chat to the enemy.
MutatorStrings.NoDeathCamDescription: Forces the death camera to be disabled for all players.
MutatorStrings.NoThirdPersonDescription: The third person camera for spectator mode is disabled.
MutatorStrings.SmallFirefightDescription: Adjusts Firefight to suit a smaller player count by adjusting round count, round timer, and capture times.
MutatorStrings.TieBreakerDescription: In Firefight, enable overtime and replaying rounds in the event of a draw.
MutatorStrings.ArmsRaceDescription: Every two kills give a new weapon. A kill with the final weapon wins the round.
MutatorStrings.StrikeDescription: No respawns, more rounds, rounds are faster.
MutatorStrings.StrikeRule1: Insurgents must destroy one of two objectives by planting timed explosive.
MutatorStrings.StrikeRule2: Security must defend the objectives until the time runs out or defuse the explosive.
MutatorStrings.StrikeRule3: Rounds are short, the team that wins more rounds takes the match.
MutatorStrings.LMGOnlyDescription: Only light machine guns are available along with normal equipment and explosives.
MutatorStrings.ChadTeam666Description: Mutator featuring 100 supply points, melee and special enemies, and vampirism.
